question: In which state of India the sex ratio is the lowest as per 2011 census data?
solution:
The correct answer is __Haryana__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sex ratio is used to describe the number of females per 1000 males.
 
• It is a valuable source for finding the population of women in India and what is the ratio of women to that of men in India.
 
• In the Population Census of 2011, it was revealed that the population ratio in India 2011 is 943 females per 1000 males.
 
• The Sex Ratio 2011 shows an upward trend from the census 2001 data.
 
• Considering all UTs and States together, as per the 2011 census, Daman & Diu has the lowest sex ratio of 618 and Kerala has the highest sex ratio of 1,084.
 
• Out of the given options, Haryana__ has the lowest sex ratio.
